title: juicy mexican jersey royal potatoes tacos
description: sweet, crispy, energizing mexican (oaxacan) dish featuring jersey royal potatoes, temper, halal-friendly.

ingredients.name: shredded cheese (such as queso fresco or Monterey Jack)

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chili powder and cumin, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the salt and black pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chopped potatoes and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Add the water and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for about 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
While the potatoes are cooking, warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Once the potatoes are done, remove them from the heat and stir in the shredded cheese.
To assemble the tacos, place a few spoonfuls of the potato mixture onto a warmed tortilla, and garnish with chopped cilantro.
